title: Lennar Q3 FY2026 results — released after the close 2026-09-16, call 2026-09-17 11:00 ET, the first large-builder demand read inside the 09-29 house-price corridor
source: EST: the company's own primary, fetched direct 2026-09-16 by this lane. investors.lennar.com/press-releases/2026/09-02-2026-213038897 (HTTP 200, 42,786 bytes), the PRNewswire release dated 2026-09-02, states verbatim that Lennar "will release its third quarter 2026 earnings after the market closes on September 16, 2026" and "will host a conference call on September 17, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time"; the same headline is carried on the investors.lennar.com landing page (HTTP 200, 48,359 bytes) fetched in the same pass. That is an `IR:` primary and would ordinarily carry the confirmed prefix. It is filed `estimate` on two counts, NEITHER of them date doubt: a sweep-discovered proposal is always `estimate` by contract (docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md; scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs fails a non-estimate proposal), and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. A SECOND independent primary was attempted and failed: data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000920760.json returned HTTP 403 to this runner, so the 8-K announcing the date was not read and is not cited. Dated 2026-09-16 because that is when the information lands — the release, not the call; LEN's first tradeable reaction is the 2026-09-17 open. Checked 2026-09-16
notes: DISCOVERED during the case-shiller-hpi-2026-09-29 D-13 pulse (2026-09-16), and it closes a structural gap rather than adding a line: this calendar carries 664 canonical events and SIX house-price ledgers whose own instrument tables are built on DHI / LEN / PHM / TOL / ITB / XHB, and not one homebuilder print is tracked anywhere in src/domain/market-events/ or src/domain/earnings-calendar.ts. So the family measures builder equities every pulse and has never once had the demand print that moves them on its board. WHY IT IS ADJACENT TO THE PROPOSER, specifically: the 09-29 ledger's pulse measured a real builder breakdown over eight sessions to 2026-09-15 — ITB -5.10%, XHB -5.32%, TOL -5.31%, LEN -4.20% against SPY -1.66%, on two distinct builder-specific down days (09-08 and 09-10) — while the index the ledger tracks is accelerating nominally (national NSA y/y +0.78% March trough to +1.53% June). Lennar's Q3 covers the quarter ended 2026-08-31 and publishes new orders, backlog, cancellation rate, average selling price and incentive load: it is the first hard read on which of those two stories the tape is pricing, and it lands 13 days before the 09-29 print. FILED `low` AND `symbols: []` DELIBERATELY, mirroring the costco-q4-fy2026-2026-09-24 precedent this lane checked before writing: LEN is not one of this house's tracked names (the earnings calendar covers NVDA/MRVL/AVGO/CRWV/MU), no house playbook is keyed to it (0 hits re-grepped 2026-09-16 across docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md), and it enters as a housing-SECTOR read — which is also why it is proposed here as kind `sector` and NOT added to src/domain/earnings-calendar.ts, a file this lane is forbidden to edit. CONSIDERED AND DECLINED alongside it, so the absences read as decisions: KB Home's Q3 FY2026 date could NOT be pinned — investor.kbhome.com returned HTTP 403 to this runner — and a builder print is not filed on a seasonal pattern alone; Lennar's own Q4 print is not filed for the same reason and would in any case sit past this calendar's 60-day research horizon; and the 2026-11-24 and 2026-12-29 Case-Shiller editions were declined on the record by the 10-27 lane as backfill rather than adjacency, so they are not re-proposed under a new owner. HONEST LIMIT ON TIMING: dated 2026-09-16 this proposal is due the moment it merges, so it buys an initial-research session at or just past D-0 rather than weeks of forward stance. That is accepted knowingly — the outcome record on the first builder print this calendar has ever carried is worth more than the forward window it does not get, and the horizon leash (#2946) excludes only what can never become due, which this is not. The proposing ledger's own call is unchanged and unchangeable by this print: stand aside, symbols: [], an estimate widens caution and licenses nothing.
